sources.title: 赤潮自走棋 更新公告 5月30日早8点停服维护
sources.attribution: 17173 labels both author and source as official; this is a preserved announcement, not client configuration.
sources.evidence: Original article body reopened and checked for the skytoad change: per-star healing, flat attack bonus, eight-second duration and shortened per-star cooldown.

sources.title: 数据汇总
sources.evidence: Archived original image visually checked again; bytes match the earlier table transcription. Player observations, not an official client dump.

mayAnnouncement.visual: Body enlarges after swallowing an enemy.

implemented.target: Highest current HP among visible enemies in range with less current HP than the caster; undying souls excluded.
implemented.damage: True damage sufficient to remove current shield and HP; ordinary immunity, reflection, death bursts, rebirth and undying transitions still resolve.
implemented.reward: Flat healing and temporary attack after lethal HP damage only while the source remains alive and is not an undying soul. Healing overflow is excluded; refresh rather than stack.
implemented.catalog: New matches use five gold and ten copies. Existing matches keep their original prices and copy limits while later preparation phases upgrade combat behavior.

localAdaptations: May ability changes and July player-measured body statistics are separate time slices, not proof of one unified original client version.
Attack 53 is the mean of 48-58. HP and ordinary attack star doubling remain local rules; skill values use the independent printed arrays.

Initial mana, the current-HP threshold, Manhattan range, target ordering, true-damage execution, visibility and resurrection interaction are local interpretations, not recovered official boundary rules.
The eight-second lifetime and flat additions are sourced; 1.18 visual scaling, multiplicative application with other attack bonuses and cooldown/energy scheduling are local choices.
Five-gold pool size ten, legacy catalog freezing and phase-aware migration are local persistence/economy rules.
The prior ImageGen skytoad asset is reused unchanged; the source image is a research artifact and is not used as game art.

verification.limitations: Two seeds and two commander policies are diagnostics, not independent human-win-rate evidence. AI deployment counts do not encode every unit's star; puppet-only detailed histories cannot prove overall AI star coverage.
